description: Defines a domain model class 'LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod' representing a repayment period in a loan schedule, including period details, financial amounts, and methods for data transformation and state management.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod
classes.description: Immutable class modeling a loan repayment period, providing accessors, state mutators, and conversion to data format.

methods.name: repayment
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod with provided parameters.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the object state into a LoanSchedulePeriodData instance.

methods.name: isRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates that this period is a repayment period (returns true).

methods.name: isDownPaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates this is not a down payment period (returns false).

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns the period number.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns the principal due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns the interest due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns fee charges due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns penalty charges due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Adds fee and penalty charges to the respective totals.

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds principal amount to principal due and total due.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: Adds interest amount to interest due and total due.

methods.name: setPeriodNumber
methods.description: Sets the period number.

methods.name: setOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Sets the outstanding loan balance.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Returns the set of loan interest recalculation details.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Checks if EMI is fixed specific to the installment.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Marks the EMI as fixed for this installment.

methods.name: setRescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Sets the reschedule interest portion.

methods.name: rescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns the reschedule interest portion.
